# Request Body Requirements Quality Checklist: Corpo de requisição JSON do registro de imagem

**Purpose**: Validate the *quality* of the contract requirements for T-002-3 — the contract's first request body, and the first artifact in the T-002 chain that generates code — before `/speckit-plan` builds on them
**Created**: 2026-07-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard · **Audience**: Reviewer (PR) · **Companion to**: [requirements.md](./requirements.md) (spec-level quality gate)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests whether the requirements are *written* well — not whether the YAML works.

## Evaluation Result (2026-07-25)

Ran against `spec.md` at generation time. **36 of 40 passed on first read; 4 failed and drove spec edits.** All 40 pass after the edits below.

| Item | Finding | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| CHK008 | **Most substantive.** FR-014 claimed "nenhum DTO preexistente é alterado", but `target/` is rebuilt on every build — with nothing captured beforehand, the claim was **unverifiable in principle**, not merely unverified. | FR-014 rewritten to require capturing the model inventory (names + content checksum) **before** the edit, with an explicit after-comparison criterion. Same lesson the 007 run learned about the test baseline, now applied to generated code. |
| CHK004 | Handling of unknown/extra properties was unspecified — a real question, since the whole payload shape was decided by *excluding* metadata. A reader could not tell whether `{url, altText}` yields `201` or `400`. | Added **FR-016**: `additionalProperties: false` is deliberately **not** declared — tolerant-reader behaviour, so a future metadata field in T-003 stays additive. Consequence spelled out in an Edge Case: `altText` is silently dropped today, and is *not* a `400` cause. |
| CHK003 | FR-001 named `application/json` but never prohibited a second media type being added alongside — leaving `multipart/form-data` technically re-addable, which is the exact thing the URL-only decision exists to exclude. | FR-001 now requires **exactly** that media type and names multipart as the excluded case. |
| CHK005 | Placement of the new schema among the existing four was unspecified. | Added an assumption: appended after `StockMovement`, noting YAML key order is semantically irrelevant and the existing list is insertion-ordered, not alphabetical. |

No item was waived. No unresolved ambiguity blocks `/speckit-plan`.

**Pattern worth noting**: three of the four failures (CHK003, CHK004, CHK005) were *unstated permissiveness* — places where the spec said what MUST be present but not what MUST NOT be added. That is the characteristic failure mode of a task whose deliverable is a **schema**: schemas are as much about what they reject as about what they accept. The T-002-1 run failed on scope boundaries and the T-002-2 run on under-specified deliverables; this run's signature is different again.
